name: proteinview
description: Render and interact with PDB and mmCIF protein structures in a ProteinView FullHD Codex pane.

interface.shortDescription: Explore PDB proteins in terminal-native FullHD.
interface.longDescription: Fetch or open protein structures, render an exact 1920×1080 ProteinView snapshot, and open a persistent interactive molecular pane in compatible Codex terminals.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me the 1UBQ PDB protein in the live FullHD viewer.
